verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs say it creates automatic preview environments on every push, gives each branch a preview URL, and keeps separate environment variables for preview, so the core per-change preview workflow is first-party. The evidence does not show previews tied to pull requests specifically, describe them as ephemeral or torn down after merge, or show full-stack backing services such as per-PR databases provisioned by Vercel itself. Database branching appears only through third-party Marketplace providers like Neon. missing for 10: explicit per-pull-request preview creation, documented ephemeral lifecycle and cleanup, first-party full-stack data isolation per preview, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can get ephemeral full-stack preview environments for every pull request

citations.quote: Connect your Git repository to deploy on every push, with automatic preview environments for testing changes before production.
Connect GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket to deploy on every push, with a preview URL for every branch.
Manage local, preview, production, and custom environments and the variables each one uses.
Let teams and invited collaborators comment on your preview and production environments.
